takes.prompt: Real, unedited footage. Natural exposure, true-to-life colours, a calm, steady camera with faint natural sway, real lens depth of field. A white ceramic bowl sits on a light wooden table near a window. The bowl features intricate dark blue painted tulips and carnations, accented with turquoise leaves and red dots. A blue line circles the rim, decorated with smaller blue flowers. The rigid, glossy ceramic reflects soft natural light. The background shows a softly blurred white wall and window frame. The camera pushes in slowly toward the front of the bowl. The gentle movement creates subtle natural parallax. Light shifts slightly across the glossy surface as the camera moves. The entire bowl stays in frame for the whole shot, maintaining its exact shape, size, and detailed floral patterns without morphing. No hands or people enter the frame. The shot ends focused on the bowl. No added captions, subtitles, logos or watermarks (keep the product's own text and logos as in the photos).
